verse: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
story: After a long night over the earth, Isaiah sees dawn arriving over one city and calls it to get up.

Darkness covers the nations, and yet the LORD's glory will rise upon Zion. Its light will draw peoples and kings to it, and in the end the LORD Himself will be her everlasting light, so that no sun or moon is needed. The command to arise is not an order to produce light. It is an invitation to stand in light that has already come. For Christians, that light has a name: Jesus, the light of the world.
Stand up in the light today. You are not asked to make it, only to stop hiding from it.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
